english: The prisoner felt sorry for him, but there was nothing else he could do.
text: feel sorry for him 在这里是同情他，不是向他道歉；道歉可说 say sorry to him。后半句 nothing else he could do 呈现战俘所认为的无其他选择，不是说他毫无行动能力，下一句恰恰写了他的行动。
author: doubao-seed-2-1-turbo-260628
